datasets.name: Customers
datasets.sql:
select id,
       name,
      to_char(id)||'-'||name as KOD from customers
where id in (select customerid from dm_contracts)
order by id

datasets.name: Deps
datasets.sql:
select
   cont.id,
   cont.contractno,
   dm_stored_programs.GetContractAccount(Acc.Contractaccid) as ContractAccNO
from dm_contracts cont,
     dm_contract_accounts acc
where cont.id = acc.id#

datasets.name: ReportData
datasets.sql:
SELECT cont.contractno,
       cont.opendate, 
       cont.closedate, 
       cont.amount,
       cont.customerid as custID,
       round(cont.amount* o.ostat,2) as eamount,  
       cont.interest,
       cont.overdueinterest, 
       cont.dueinterest,
       av.val_name,
       dm_stored_programs.GetContractAccountName(acc.contractaccid) AS custname,
       dm_stored_programs.GetContractBalNo(Cont.ID) as Balans,
       dm_stored_programs.GetContractAccount (acc.contractaccid) AS contractaccno,
       dm_stored_programs.GetContractaccount (acc.interestaccid) AS interestaccno,
       dm_stored_programs.GetContractAccount (acc.clientaccid) AS clientaccno,
       dm_stored_programs.GetContractAccount(acc.bonusaccid) AS agentaccno,
       dm_stored_programs.GetCustomerName(cont.agentid) as agentname,
       h.facticaldebt,
       round(h.facticaldebt * o.ostat,2) AS efacticaldebt, 
       h.facticalinterestdebt,
       round(h.facticalinterestdebt * o.ostat,2) AS efacticalinterestdebt,
       cat.CATEGORY, 
       per.NAME as pername, 
       dt.TYPE, 
       fil.NAME as filname,
       h.facticaldebt+h.facticalinterestdebt as Payamt,
       round(h.facticaldebt* o.ostat,2) +round(h.facticalinterestdebt* o.ostat,2)  as EPayamt,
       dm_stored_programs.GetFirstClosedat(cont.id) as firstopdate,
       (select name from user$ where id=cont.sid#) username,
       (select description||'('||(select withdrtypedesc from dm_addtypes where withdrtype=depcap.type#)||')' from dm_depcapitalperiods depcap where depcap.id=cont.capitalperid) capitalperiodname,
       (select  depper.description  from dm_depperiods depper where depper.id=cont.periodid) periodname,
       (select passer||paspnum from custinfo where idcust=cont.customerid)passport,
       (select passpin from custinfo where idcust=cont.customerid)passpin,
       (select birthday from custinfo where idcust=cont.customerid)birthday,
       decode(cont.prizeid,0,'Verilməsin',1,'Verilsin(müddətin əvvəlində)',2,'Verilsin(müddətin sonunda)')prizename             
   FROM dm_contracts cont,
       dm_contract_accounts acc,
       dm_contract_history h,
       operkurs o,
       dm_categories cat,
       filial fil,
       dm_types dt,
       dm_persons per,
       avalute av
 WHERE h.hdate = :dat
   AND o.dat = :dat
   AND cont.ID = acc.id#
   AND cont.ID = h.id#
   AND cont.currency = o.val_kod
   AND cont.currency = av.valute
   AND cont.clienttype = cat.ID
   AND cont.branchid = fil.ID
   AND cont.contracttype = dt.ID

   AND cont.personaltype = per.custtype_id and cont.type# in (3,4)
   AND per.rez_qrez_id=cat.rezcategory
   AND cont.opendate<=:dat

datasets.name: Contracts
